prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1440; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the individual injured in the rear-end collision described in the enclosed materials, and all further communication concerning this matter should be directed to our office rather than to our client. Please do not contact our client directly by telephone, mail, or in person, and route any requests for statements, recorded interviews, or authorizations through this firm.

Our client sustained injuries that required medical treatment and continue to affect daily activities. We are gathering the documentation needed to present a full claim, and we will provide it once treatment and records are complete.

To assist in evaluating this matter, please provide a certified copy of the declarations page and the full policy limits for bodily injury and property damage coverage applicable to the at-fault driver, along with confirmation of any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply.

Please also take immediate steps to preserve all evidence relating to this loss. This includes vehicle data and telematics, photographs, dash camera footage, recorded statements, adjuster notes, claim file materials, repair estimates, and any communications with the insured or third parties. Routine deletion or destruction of such materials should be suspended until this matter is resolved.
